items.title: Paul Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: listen to Oscar and the guys that are at the top of the jazz scene... to me the best jazz pianist going today is Oscar. Bar none.

ctx.x: And a couple of them played a little bit of something, but the mind doesn’t work that way. But if your mind works in an improvisational way and hears a whole lot of things, you can play a concerto on a C chord. But it is something you’re born with. You can learn a lot of licks, you can listen to Oscar and the guys that are at the top of the jazz scene, and Oscar will play [scats] — so I can sound just like Oscar, but I mean that’s not improvising. Playing something he played, then he might as well write it out…
He’s got the really hip substitutions, huh?
